system_description.narrative_title: Escalating Russia–Ukraine conflict: energy strikes and geopolitical spillovers
system_description.narrative_summary: A sharp intensification of the Russia–Ukraine war dominates the window: Ukrainian strikes increasingly target Russian energy and logistics infrastructure while Russia conducts missile and drone barrages against Ukrainian cities and assets, producing civilian casualties. The dynamics are producing geopolitical spillovers — damaged embassies, incidents in neighboring states, strains on EU/US sanction unity, and threats to Black Sea grain and global energy flows. Treated as an open system, this conflict consists of interacting military, economic (energy/commodities), diplomatic and information flows, with reinforcing feedbacks (attacks → counterattacks → market shocks → political pressure) and delays in political/arms responses.
system_description.scope: Military engagements between Russia and Ukraine (including drone/missile strikes and targeted attacks on energy/logistics), the sanctions regime and its political support in Europe/US, impacts on energy and grain exports, adjacent diplomatic incidents and regional spillovers (Poland, Baltics, Black Sea), and domestic political decisions affecting procurement and support.
system_description.super_system: The international security order and global political economy
adjacent_subsystems: European energy markets and supply chains
Global food and maritime trade (Black Sea grain exports)
NATO/US domestic politics and arms procurement/supply
Regional security of neighboring states (Poland, Baltics, Black Sea littoral)

variables.name: Military attack intensity
variables.description: Rate and scale of offensive military strikes (missile, drone, kinetic) across the conflict zone per unit time.

variables.name: Defensive capacity
variables.description: Aggregate ability of defensive systems and forces to detect, intercept and absorb incoming attacks.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure vulnerability
variables.description: Susceptibility of energy production, processing and distribution assets to damage or disruption.

variables.name: Energy export throughput
variables.description: Volume of energy commodities and related flows moving from production areas to external markets per unit time.

variables.name: Grain export throughput
variables.description: Volume of agricultural commodity shipments leaving the region toward global markets per unit time.

variables.name: Sanctions enforcement coherence
variables.description: Degree of alignment and consistent application among sanctioning actors and mechanisms.

variables.name: Political support for external aid
variables.description: Level of domestic political backing for providing military, economic or humanitarian assistance to conflict parties.

variables.name: Diplomatic tension level
variables.description: Intensity of diplomatic strain and hostile interactions across bilateral and multilateral relationships in the region.

variables.name: Regional spillover incident rate
variables.description: Frequency of cross-border or neighboring-state incidents (incursions, accidents, diplomatic breaches) per unit time.

variables.name: Energy market price volatility
variables.description: Magnitude and frequency of short-term fluctuations in global energy and fuel prices.

variables.name: Civilian casualty rate
variables.description: Number of civilian fatalities and serious injuries caused by hostilities per unit time.

variables.name: Displaced population stock
variables.description: Total number of internally displaced persons and refugees resulting from the conflict at a given time.

variables.name: Logistics resilience
variables.description: Capacity of transport, storage and supply networks to sustain movement of goods and military supplies under stress.

variables.name: Defense procurement rate
variables.description: Pace at which military equipment, munitions and support systems are ordered, delivered and integrated per unit time.

variables.name: Information warfare intensity
variables.description: Scale and aggressiveness of propaganda, misinformation and information operations aimed at domestic and external audiences.

variables.name: Trade and transport restriction level
variables.description: Degree of formal and informal constraints on trade, shipping and transit affecting commodity flows and logistics.

catalysts.title: Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infrastructure
catalysts.description: Ongoing campaign of Ukrainian drone/missile strikes targeting Russian refineries, petrol stations and energy plants is likely to continue in coming months.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukraine adapts strikes on Russian energy industry...', 'Russia targets hundreds of Ukrainian petrol stations', 'Ryazan refinery halted oil processing', 'Drone attack ignites blaze at energy plant'

catalysts.title: Extended Russian fuel export bans and third‑country processing talks
catalysts.description: Russia's diesel/gasoline export bans through Jan 2027 and talks with Kazakhstan to process crude will reshape flows and encourage circumvention or rerouting.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russia extends diesel, gasoline export bans until end of January 2027', 'Kazakhstan in talks to process Russian crude amid Russia fuel shortages'

catalysts.title: Legislative fights over new Russia sanctions
catalysts.description: Debates and votes in the EU and US (tariff provisions, shipping carve-outs) will shape sanction scope and enforcement coherence in coming weeks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Tariff provisions could doom long-awaited Russia sanctions bill', 'EU faces crumbling support', 'Greek shipping carve-out prompts EU rethink'

catalysts.title: Elevated cross‑border spillover and NATO border incidents
catalysts.description: Missile falling in Poland, embassy damage and border closures raise risk of additional cross-border incidents and diplomatic escalations near NATO states.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'PM Tusk says Russian missile appears to have come down in eastern Poland', 'Poland summons Russian ambassador', 'Lithuanian embassy in Kyiv damaged', 'Latvia closes border with Belarus'

catalysts.title: Increased naval interdictions of sanctioned shipping
catalysts.description: EU-led boardings of sanctioned tankers indicate stepped-up maritime enforcement against Russia's 'shadow fleet', likely to continue and affect flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Italian-led EU force boards sanctioned tanker from Russia's "shadow fleet" in Mediterranean', 'Greek shipping carve-out prompts EU rethink'

catalysts.title: US decision on Patriot interceptor deliveries
catalysts.description: US internal debate and Kyiv appeals may lead to a near-term decision on Patriot systems, altering Ukraine's air-defence capacity if approved.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukraine appeals for Patriot interceptors', 'Donald Trump ‘not sure’ he will let Ukraine build Patriot missiles', 'Zelenskyy reports positive Oval Office meeting'

catalysts.title: Disruption to Black Sea grain and shipping
catalysts.description: Attacks on vessels, ports and warnings from grain lobby indicate likely reduced Black Sea grain export throughput and related shipping disruptions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russian grain lobby says Kyiv's attacks threaten Black Sea exports', 'Rosatom says its civilian vessel sank in Black Sea after Ukrainian drone attack'

catalysts.title: Strikes on retail and logistics warehouses
catalysts.description: Attacks on commercial warehouses (Wildberries, Ozon) and logistics hubs likely to continue, disrupting supply chains and raising civilian impact and information attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukraine strikes two more warehouses of Russian online retailer Wildberries', 'Ozon says Ukrainian drone alert forces it to evacuate Tatarstan warehouse', 'Founder of Wildberries calls Ukrainian attacks "acts of terrorism"'

catalysts.title: Allegation Russia used a North Korean missile
catalysts.description: Claims that Russia used a North Korean missile may trigger investigations, diplomatic pressure and potential sanctions or arms-tracing responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russia used N.Korean missile for deadly strike on Ukrainian village, Zelenskiy says'
